text:
alex: FYI — Presto (FinTech) POC kickoff today. Goal: embed LLM into transaction support flow. Need to lock prompt set, evals, timeline, and call out any enterprise/security blockers. 3-week POC. @maria can you help scope?

maria: On it. Quick Q: what are the top 3 use cases and must-have success criteria from the customer's side?

alex: Primary: automated dispute triage + suggested responses. Secondary: entity extraction for merchant/category tags and routing. Must-haves: accuracy for triage suggestions, low hallucination on amounts/accounts, response latency within product constraints.

devin: I'll draft a baseline prompt bundle and minimal eval set. Proposal: start with 8 golden examples per use case + 50 blind samples. Quick baseline prompts (first pass):

```
Prompt A (triage): "You are a compliance assistant. Given a customer message about a transaction dispute, classify into: refund_request / fraud_claim / chargeback_claim / info_request. Provide a 1-sentence suggested response and list any missing data fields needed"

Prompt B (reply gen): "Write a concise, compliant reply (<= 120 chars) acknowledging the issue, next steps, and a gentle ask for missing data. Do not provide financial advice."

Prompt C (entities): "Extract: transaction_amount, merchant_name, transaction_date, last4, category. Return as JSON only."
```

devin: Suggested baseline metrics: intent classification F1 >= 0.85, reply helpfulness >= 4/5 (human eval), hallucination rate < 5% (measured as incorrect or fabricated account/amounts), 95th perc latency <= 250ms for single-thread requests.

jia: Security questions: will any PII be sent? Presto says they can tokenise full PANs but might send last4 and masked identifiers. They asked about audit logs and data residency (EU). Need answers for their security questionnaire (SaaS + dedicated options).

alex: Good catch. For POC we can offer: masked-only by default, dedicated infra optional — we should surface the Dedicated/Private options and how quickly we can spin. Also note KMS integration and audit logs.

maria: Timeline suggestion: Week 0 (this week) — finalize prompt set + seed evals. Week 1 — run baseline on hosted models + collect metrics. Week 2 — iterate prompts, run A/B with a quantized variant if needed. Week 3 — customer demo + handoff docs. Is that aggressive?

devin: I can have the baseline prompts + eval harness by EOD tomorrow. Will include spec for human eval labels and an automated script to compute F1/hallucination. Example eval runner snippet:

```
python eval_runner.py --prompts baseline_prompts.json --gold gold_set.json --out results.json
# outputs: intent_f1, avg_helpfulness, halluc_count
```

ops-bot: FYI pricing anchor: https://redwood.example/pricing — rough hosted POC cost estimate for 3 weeks ~ $1.2k (tokens + infra). Dedicated estimate depends on minimum commit. Contact billing for exact quote.

maria: We'll need a one-pager for the customer that maps prompts -> acceptance tests. I'll draft. Alex: can you confirm which datasets/examples Presto will share (PII redaction level)?

alex: I'll ask them to share 100 anonymized threads (mask last4 ok). Also ask legal for an NDA addendum.

jia: For security questionnaire: list of required items from our side — SOC2 status, data residency options, KMS support, audit logs retention, and support contact. I'll start a draft answers doc and ping security.

devin: One operational note: include KV cache warmup on common prefixes (refund, dispute, chargeback) to reduce cold-start latency for demos.

maria: Assignments: devin -> baseline prompts + eval harness, maria -> customer-facing acceptance matrix + demo plan, jia -> security questionnaire draft, alex -> collect sample data + legal. Expected deliverables by EOD Friday.

alex: Perfect. If anyone hits sec blockers, ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: create project in Console for "presto-pilot" to track costs and models: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood.example/projects -d '{"name":"presto-pilot"}'`

maria: Added a short checklist in the Presto Confluence page — link: https://redwood.example/confluence/presto-pilot (will update with acceptance matrix). :eyes:

devin: Quick question — for hallucination measurement, do we count wrong merchant names as hallucination or only fabricated new account numbers? leaning to count both, but flag severity.
jia: Agree count both; severity tiering is useful. We'll include manual review for high-severity cases.

alex: OK — final note: keep prompts conservative (system persona emphasises "do not invent account numbers or offer refunds without verification"). We'll reconvene Friday standup for status.

maria: Thanks team — I'll set a 30-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:

alex: Thanks all.
